description: The statement of account of one customer or supplier over a period: the balance carried forward from before it, then every posted line of their receivable and payable accounts — date, journal, entry, the document it books, debit, credit and running balance — and the balance the period ends on. Debit minus credit, in the company currency: positive is what the contact owes the company, negative what the company owes them. Each line says how far a matching has settled it today (matching_state open, partial or matched, and open_amount). Drafts are not in it. It is the ledger read for one contact, the same figures aged_balance gives.

company_id.description: The company to work in. Ask list_companies if unsure.

from.description: First day of the period. The balance carried forward is the one before it.

name: contact_statement
title: Statement of a contact
